slides.text: LLM on Snapdragon LM Studio for snapdragon - https://lmstudio.ai/snapdragon Windows Laptops with new Snapdragon X Elite chips will be able to run LLMs effectively using on-chip NPU and fast memory. They are affordable ($1K .. $2K). LM Studio - has already created a version for Snapdragon - and demonstrated 20 tokens/sec for Llama-7b-q4 on CPU. NPU support is pending - waiting for llama.cpp support. Both LM Studio and Ollama are using llama.cpp https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp Ollama - waiting ( https://github.com/ollama/ollama ).
